event.summary: A fixed container-creation card can authorize a different SSH machine
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 190d844e58c96cf197aa838d0b0eea8062f48435. TLDR: a user can Allow a card naming the original container host after that host's SSH destination changes, and Farhelm creates the container and runs the approved command on the replacement machine instead. Interface g020/l1 line 9 identified this route; source checks here confirm the physical-target mismatch independently. Source: approvals.rs:1093-1104 renders the captured place_name; agent_requests.rs:4485-4515 captures that name and numeric Place, but no endpoint guard; approved():2865-2886 validates only origin after asking. :4519-4528 checks only a clone source, and :4541-4548 submits the numeric place. hosts.rs:1132-1165 permits retarget under its own provisioning/write locks; store.rs:7566-7602 checks only existing Podman references before changing destination; store/podman.rs:215-250 counts existing environment rows and retained recipe resources, not pending approvals. environment/podman.rs:148-184 resolves the current endpoint for commands and checks it against the current probe; :975-1033 permits fresh preparation/build at that current place.
